name: Karakuchi Hibana
source:
A girl whom Kento helps out on his school trip and later becomes acquainted with each other. Attending a prestigious all-girls school and is admired by the students there due to her personality, she has a strong sense of justice, but can sometime be too honest. Even though she does not know much about it, she longs to experience romance.

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1206724]Getchu[/url]]
